rules.one_owner: Every keyword (EN and ES, compared exactly and after dropping stopwords, folding plurals and sorting words) belongs to exactly one page or post.
rules.es_primary: Eddy County Spanish planner term for the page's intent; if Eddy shows only a 10/mo floor long-tail variant and a head phrase has >=10x its US-es volume, the head phrase is primary and the Eddy variant a secondary; no evidence = natural phrase, low/no data.

sources.eddy: Google Ads Keyword Planner ideas, Eddy County NM, English; 12-month average (pulled 2026-10-24). 10/mo is the planner's floor bucket.
sources.eddy_es: Google Ads Keyword Planner ideas, Eddy County NM, Spanish language setting; 12-month average. 10/mo is the floor bucket.
sources.carlsbad: Google Ads Keyword Planner ideas, Carlsbad NM (city).
sources.us: Google Ads Keyword Planner, United States, English, 12-month average (pulled 2026-10-24).
sources.us_es: Google Ads Keyword Planner, United States, Spanish language setting (pulled 2026-10-24). The planner does not split volume by language: an English string returns the same number under es (e.g. 'taper fade' 246,000 in both), so only Spanish phrases measure Spanish demand.
sources.gbp: Divinely Faded Google Business Profile search terms, Oct 2025 to Sep 2026 (12-month totals; '<15' = Google's privacy threshold).
sources.autocomplete: Google autocomplete suggestions for Carlsbad barber seeds (EN + ES).
sources.masked: Google withholds volume for many children/youth terms (planner and clickstream both return nothing). Proxy: 'corte de pelo para niños' 2,400/mo US-es and autocomplete.
